name: Remainders and modular cycles
definition: When you divide and something is left over, that leftover repeats on a cycle. If today is Tuesday, then 100 days from now depends only on the remainder of 100 divided by 7. Finding the cycle length and the position inside it answers questions about enormous numbers.
recognizeWhen: what day of the week will it be in many days
the pattern repeats every so many steps
what is left over when you divide
the beads or tiles repeat in a fixed order
misconceptions: I divided and used the quotient when the question wanted the leftover.
I counted the starting day as day one and shifted my whole answer by one.
I found the cycle length but then counted forward the full number instead of the remainder.
